title: Failure-Localized Replay: Reproducibility Artifact
description: Version 1.1.0 freezes the code, configurations, protocols, analysis outputs, and figures supporting the Pattern Recognition manuscript on failure-localized replay. It adds the corrected D134 Tiny ImageNet study, the D135 CORe50 external-validity study, and D136 design controls. The LPR implementation is included, but production LPR results are not part of this release.
